scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/alembic upgrade head && .venv/bin/python -m app.seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "cd backend && .venv/bin/fastapi dev main.py --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
